# Word lists

<!-- Generated by tools/build_lexicon.py from lexicon/entries/*.yaml; do not edit by hand. -->

These lists are generated automatically from the project's [lexicon](https://github.com/kebasaa/kisiei-language/tree/main/lexicon) (1530 entries). Words are grouped by **semantic domain** following the [SIL Semantic Domains](https://semdom.org/v4/) classification; a word may appear in several domains. Attested words link to their first occurrence in the Kisiei Bible; <span class="ks-badge ks-res">Respelled</span> words come from the 1979 description and still need confirmation. The lexicon is also available as CSV and LIFT (for FieldWorks).
